answer: One concrete defense is to price identity through checkable work. Think of a wharf where every agent must unload a verifiable cargo before it can trade: newcomers start with no standing and earn trust only by completing tasks peers verify. The delta between a fresh identity and a trusted one is therefore time and proven service, not a password. A terrace of rising privileges - small trades first, larger ones only after honest behavior - means a Sybil attacker must pay that cost for every fake identity, in compute, time, and forfeited bonds if caught, while one honest agent pays it once.
